item.title: BE ALERT - YELLOW WARNING - RAINFALL - IN EFFECT
item.description:
Generic Warning | Yellow Warning - Rainfall - In Effect |

As of Thursday evening rain, heavy at times, is spreading into southeastern Saskatchewan, and will move into portions of western Manitoba later this evening. The rain is expected to continue all night and through Friday before tapering off Friday evening. Total rainfall in the area covered by this warning will range from 50-70 mm. Surrounding regions (where a special weather is in effect) will see lessor amounts of 20 -50 mm. Water will likely pool on roads and in low-lying areas. Some travel delays are possible. Local utility outages are possible. Some property damage is possible. Please continue to monitor alerts and forecasts issued by Environment Canada. To report severe weather, send an email to MBstorm@ec.gc.ca, call 1-800-239-0484 or post reports on social media using MBStorm.

| Moderate - possible threat | Future - act in near future | Kenton, Manitoba

item.title: Premier Rob Lantz announces changes to Senior Management Team
item.description:
Premier Rob Lantz announces changes to Senior Management Team ssdrummond Thu, 08/13/2026 - 15:23

Premier Rob Lantz announced changes today to the senior management team within the Government of Prince Edward Island.

The following changes will take effect as of August 21, 2026:

  • Norbert Carpenter to serve as Deputy Minister of Education and Early Years;
  • Bobbi Jo Flynn to serve as Deputy Minister of Social Development and Seniors;
  • Doriann MacMillan to serve as Chief Executive Officer of the PEI Energy Corporation; and
  • Ryan Neale to serve as Deputy Minister of Land and Environment.

“These are experienced leaders who understand our province, our public service and the work that needs to be done for Islanders. Each brings strong leadership and a wealth of experience to their new role, and I look forward to working with them as we continue to deliver on the priorities that matter to Islanders.”
- Premier Rob Lantz

John Cummings will return to his role as Executive Director of Educational Services after serving as Acting Deputy Minister of Education and Early Years. Cummings has been with the department since 2018.

“I want to sincerely thank John for stepping into the role of Acting Deputy Minister and for the leadership he has provided to Education and Early Years. His experience, guidance and commitment to support Island children and young people have been greatly appreciated,” said Premier Rob Lantz.

Gordon MacFadyen will become President of Slemon Park Corporation.

“I want to thank Gordon for his more than 20 years of service to the provincial government,” said Premier Rob Lantz. “His experience and leadership have made an important contribution across government, and I wish him well as he takes on this new role.”

item.title: Premier McLeod on the Enbridge Line 21 Pipeline
item.description:
YELLOWKNIFE - Premier Bob McLeod issued the following statement on the Enbridge Line 21 pipeline today:

“I was pleased to learn that operations have resumed for Enbridge’s Line 21 pipeline after almost 2 years of no activity.

"Resource development has, and will continue to be, the backbone of our economy and is central to ensuring a good source of middle class jobs and business opportunities. Our territory has mineral and petroleum resources and the development of those resources can have a transformative effect on our people and economy.

"Sustainable economic development is key to the future of Northerners. With a strong resource development base, we will be able to support diversification of our local economies into emerging and established sectors.

"On behalf of the Government of the Northwest Territories I’d like to offer my congratulations to Imperial Oil, Enbridge the town of Norman Wells and other partners for getting this pipeline back up and running. I know the efforts and economic impacts of the pipeline have already begun to take shape in the community and will be felt for years to come. ”

 

Charlotte Digness
Media and Communications Coordinator
Cabinet Communications and Protocol
Government of the Northwest Territories
Ph: 867-767-9140 ext. 11092
